detail: H. H. Cole, Illustrations of Ancient Buildings in Kashmir, India Museum, London, 1869, Plate 1–68. The measured plan gives an octagonal enclosure about 55.4 ft across, central building about 34.4 ft across, and a projecting front staircase. The published elevation is a restoration proposal.
British Library Photo 1000/11(1243), Burke photograph no. 2 as published in Cole, 1869. The plate caption names the shrine and the 1868 exposure.
Archaeological description records the 20-foot octagonal basement, solid rock and pediment projections on four sides.
The official inventory shows the surviving temple plan and axial stairs. Written controls only.
